OUR SPECIALIZED SERVICES
Footing & Raft Foundation
Deep excavation, isolated/raft footings & pile cap casting.
Column, Beam & Slab RCC
Monolithic framing with M25–M60 concrete grade compliance.
Reinforcement / Steel Binding
Precision BBS cutting, high-tensile Fe550D rebar & automated tying.
Shuttering & Formwork
Heavy-duty plywood, steel plates & cuplock staging systems.
Mivan / Aluminium Formwork
Fast-track monolithic aluminium shuttering cycles for high-rise.
Concrete Pouring & Placement
Transit mixer pumping, boom placers & mechanical needle compaction.
Staircase RCC Work
Doglegged, cantilevered & spiral staircase precision shuttering.
Shear Wall & Core Works
High-stress seismic shear walls, lift shafts & structural cores.
AAC Blockwork & Masonry
High-grade AAC block masonry, fly ash bricks & polymer joint mortars.
Internal & External Plaster
2-coat sand-faced plaster, gypsum punning & continuous curing.
Civil Finishing Works
Terrace waterproofing, sunken slab treatment & structural screeding.
Technical Labour Supply
Certified bar benders, shuttering carpenters, masons & supervisors.
